newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo, Kumho to join Odyssey project.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo, Kumho to join Odyssey project.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo Corp said on Tuesday it and the Kumho Group had agreed in principle with TRW Inc of the United States and Teleglobe Inc of Canada to join the Odyssey telecommunications project.

If the contract is signed, Daewoo and Kumho would invest $150 million for a combined 9.4 percent stake in Odyssey Telecommunications, a multi-billion dollar consortium to provide satellite-based telecommunications services, a Daewoo statement said.
A formal contract was expected to be signed during the first half of this year, the statement said.
TRW and Teleglobe lead the consortium, which is expected to launch satellite-based mobile communications services in the early 2000s, it said.
Daewoo Corp is a trading and construction affiliate of the Daewoo Group DWGR.CN. Kumho Group's affiliates include international airliner Asiana Airlines and tyre-maker Kumho and Co Inc.
